subject: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@meridiancare.com>, procurement@meridiancare.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot

Oliver / procurement team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m proposing a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lets us run DPA redlines and evidence collection in parallel with MSA negotiations so we can hit a pilot start window while legal finishes the full orderflow. High-level ask: please confirm that MeridianCare is comfortable with a phased signature (Pilot Order Form -> Full MSA) and that procurement can accept a conditional PO for Phase 1.

Attachments: Meridian_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP draft), OrderForm_template.pdf (pilot scope).

Key points / open items:
- Parallel path: DPA review (legal) + SOC2 evidence intake (security) to run concurrently with MSA commercial redlines.
- Phase 1: pilot order form (limited users, capped data) — allows us to run integration testing and generate initial metrics.
- Phase 2: full MSA + signed DPA and orderform expansion.
- Procurement ask: earliest date you could execute a conditional PO (even if final MSA is pending)?

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 1: DPA redlines circulated (legal) / SOC2 evidence request submitted (security).
- Week 2: Procurement review and confirm PO pathway.
- Week 3: DocuSign route for Pilot Order Form (canary sign).

If this approach works, Laura (legal) will lead DPA redlines and I’ll coordinate the MAP updates and Drive artifacts.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize the map for the procurement loop?

Thanks —
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0124

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@meridiancare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: MeridianCare Procurement <procurement@meridiancare.com>, Maya Patel <maya.p@meridiancare.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot

Sofia —

Thanks for the clear summary. MeridianCare is open to a phased approach; procurement wants the Pilot PO to be contingent on receiving the SOC2 in-scope evidence (we need the control matrix and evidence of encryption at rest). If you can run DPA redlines in parallel with legal, that would help speed things up.

Two quick questions:
1) Can the pilot order form include a 30-day cancellation clause if evidentiary items are late?
2) What payment terms are you able to accept for the pilot PO (Net 30 vs Net 45)?

I’m looping procurement and Maya (comms) — we’d prefer a short call next Tuesday (May 25) to align owners and sign-off thresholds.

On Tue, May 18, 2026 at 09:12 Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> Oliver / procurement team —
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m proposing a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lets us run DPA redlines and evidence collection in parallel with MSA negotiations so we can hit a pilot start window while legal finishes the full orderflow.
> 
> Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize the map for the procurement loop?
> 
> — Sofia

Regards,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Director, IT Procurement — MeridianCare
oliver.grant@meridiancare.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot

Sofia / team —

We can run DPA redlines in parallel with MSA commercial negotiations. Below are items we’ll need from MeridianCare to keep the parallel path moving (I’ve attached a DPA skeleton with our starting redlines):

Required from MeridianCare (targets to preserve timeline):
- Control matrix and SOC2 in-scope evidence (security) — ideally within 5 business days of MAP acceptance.
- Confirmation of data residency requirements and any state-specific clauses.
- Procurement confirmation on whether a conditional PO (pilot-specific) is acceptable.

Proposed internal cadence and SLAs:
- Legal (Redwood) will turn initial DPA counter within 3 business days of receiving MeridianCare redlines.
- If MeridianCare redlines exceed material changes (e.g., indemnity, retention > 90), expect an additional review cycle of 4–7 business days.

Fallbacks and mitigations:
- If SOC2 evidence is delayed beyond 15 calendar days, propose an interim risk-mitigation arrangement: limited data scope + escrowed credits in pilot order form (sample clause included).

Attachments: DPA_redlines_MeridianCare.docx

Sofia — once the procurement response is in, I’ll prioritize DPA comments to avoid blocking the Pilot Order Form.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@meridiancare.com>, MeridianCare Procurement <procurement@meridiancare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot — consolidated plan

Oliver / Procurement —

Appreciate the quick replies. I’ve consolidated the MAP and proposed a concrete two-phase close that aligns with Laura’s legal cadence and your SOC2 ask. Drive link and updated artifacts are below. Please review and confirm owners so we can lock the DocuSign routing for the Pilot Order Form.

Updated MAP highlights (attached: Meridian_MAP_v3.xlsx):
- Phase 0 (Prep, owner: MeridianCare): Control matrix + initial evidence pack — target: 2026-05-21 (if you can’t hit 21, please state new ETA).
- Phase 1 (Pilot sign, owner: Procurement / Sales): Limited-scope Pilot Order Form signed via DocuSign — target: 2026-05-27. Pilot limited to 50 seats; 30-day cancellation clause (drafted). Payment: Net 30 preferred by Redwood; can confirm Net 45 for this pilot if procurement requires.
- Phase 2 (Full commercial close, owner: Legal / Procurement): Final MSA + DPA executed, Order Form expansion — target: 2026-06-14.

Owners & SLAs: 
- Redwood Legal (Laura) — DPA turnaround: 3 business days per exchange.
- MeridianCare Security — evidence delivery: 5 business days target.
- Procurement — confirm conditional PO acceptance & cancellation clause by 5/24 EOD.

Risk gates & mitigations:
- If evidence >15 days late: Pilot proceeds with limited data scope + refundable credit (escrow) in Pilot OF.
- If DPA redlines require material changes, Laura will triage priority clauses to keep Pilot OF unblockable.

Related links & artifacts: 
- MAP (editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcd-Map-Drive-Link
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5789/MDN-2026-0478
- DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/EG-12345-MDN

Next steps (requested):
1) Procurement to confirm acceptance of conditional PO + cancellation wording by 5/24 EOD.
2) MeridianCare Security to confirm evidence ETA in reply.
3) If all aligned, Redwood will seed DocuSign for Pilot Order Form on 5/26 to enable signature on 5/27.

Thanks — I’ll plan the alignment call for Tue 5/25 at 10am PT as suggested by Oliver unless I hear otherwise.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@meridiancare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, MeridianCare Procurement <procurement@meridiancare.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@meridiancare.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clearance Ladder: Parallel MSA/DPA staging and MAP for MeridianCare pilot — consolidated plan

Sofia / team —

We’re aligned on the phased approach. Procurement accepts a conditional PO for the pilot with the 30-day cancellation clause; will confirm Net 45 in writing on the 5/25 call (need internal approval but it’s likely). Security will send the SOC2 control matrix and the initial evidence packet by EOD Tuesday 5/25 (they’ve committed to that window).

Please go ahead and seed the DocuSign for the Pilot Order Form on 5/26. We’ll be on the 5/25 call to finalize the routing.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running.

Cheers,
Oliver Grant
Director, IT Procurement — MeridianCare
oliver.grant@meridiancare.com
body_preview: Proposed two-phase close: Pilot Order Form (conditional PO) -> Full MSA + DPA; request procurement confirm conditional PO & SOC2 evidence ETA by 5/24 EOD.
